description: Source code for generating a unique file identifier based on ELF file contents, specifically the .text section, using MD5 hashing. Includes functions for ELF parsing, section extraction, and identifier conversion.

classes.name: AutoElfEnder
classes.description: RAII class to ensure elf_end is called on an Elf* object upon destruction.

classes.name: AutoCloser
classes.description: RAII class to ensure file descriptor is closed upon destruction.

methods.name: FindElfTextSection
methods.description: Locates the .text section in an ELF file and returns its start address and size.

methods.name: FileID::ElfFileIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a 16-byte MD5 hash of the ELF file's .text section.

methods.name: FileID::ConvertIdentifierToString
methods.description: Converts a 16-byte identifier into a null-terminated string representation.
